name: pain-point-statusline
description: After each turn, extracts the user's current pain point from the conversation, fetches a matching Monetzly ad, and surfaces it in the status line.

interface.shortDescription: Show the user's current pain point at the status line
interface.longDescription: Adds a SessionStart hook that, if no Monetzly API key is configured yet, quietly asks Claude to request one from the user once (declining just means pain-point-only mode, no ads) and persist it to ~/.pain-point-statusline/config.json. Adds a UserPromptSubmit hook that quietly asks Claude to judge the previous exchange's pain point in its own words (first-person, e.g. "I'm feeling frustrated") and record it via a one-line Bash call before addressing the new message — no blocking, no subprocess model call, no visible narration. That call also fires a detached, fire-and-forget process that calls Monetzly's decide API with the pain point and merges the resulting ad into the same state file once it resolves. A detected pain point (or ad) stays displayed until a new one is actually detected; neutral turns don't clear it. Ships a statusline script that reads the resulting state file and renders the ad if one was fetched, otherwise the plain pain point. Requires the user to point Claude Code's statusLine setting at scripts/statusline.mjs (plugins cannot register a status line directly) — see README.md.
